title: NPDev Model Validation Report
description: Typed, loopable diagnostic report emitted by the standalone model validator (ModelValidatorMain / `npdev validate app`). Runs the same structural + semantic validation the generator runs, without generating, so an AI-authoring agent can self-correct a draft model.json before a full build.

status.description: passed = no errors and no warnings; warning = warnings only; failed = at least one error.

diagnostic.description: One validation finding. Optional fields are omitted (not null) when the validator has no value for them.

layer.description: Which validation pass produced this finding.

code.description: Stable machine code for the finding (e.g. unknown_reference_target). Absent when the pass did not assign one.

path.description: Authoring path to the offending node (e.g. concepts[User].fields[ghostId]).

suggestedFix.description: Actionable, human-readable fix hint the AI-authoring loop can apply.

helpKey.description: Documentation lookup key for this diagnostic class.
